points.description: States that a function signature includes the function's name and the types of its parameters (parameter types/list), in any wording.
points.partial_credit: Half or more (2 marks) if only one of name or parameter types is given, or parameters are mentioned vaguely (e.g. 'the parameters') without types.

points.description: Both elements are given together: the function name AND the parameter types, with no incorrect element added as part of the signature (e.g. not stating that the body is included).

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the signature consists of the function name and the parameter types (or parameter list), in any wording, even briefly. Part marks if only the name or only the parameters are given, or parameters are mentioned without types. No marks for answers that describe only what a function does or its body without naming these elements. Including the return type as an extra is acceptable and not penalised.
